QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_4

question.text: Nilgiri Multi-Strategy Fund (Cat III, close-ended, 5-year tenor) has committed capital of INR 80 crore. At end of Year 5, NAV (pre-incentives) is INR 110 crore. Hurdle rate is 10% (compounded annual). Reference Hurdle NAV = 80 x (1.10)^5 = INR 128.84 crore. Incentive fee rate is 20%. What incentive fee is payable to the manager?

answer.text: Zero — NAV is below Reference Hurdle

explanation.text: The Logic: Incentive fee = max(0, NAV − higher of HWM and Reference Hurdle) × incentive-fee rate. NAV (INR 110 cr) is below the Reference Hurdle (INR 128.84 cr), so the qualifying amount is zero and the incentive fee is zero. The workbook example uses compounded annual hurdle arithmetic of this type. The Trap: INR 6 cr applies 20% to the 30 cr gain without the hurdle test. INR 4 cr applies 20% to (110 − 80 − 20 set-aside). INR 22 cr applies 20% to NAV directly. Note: When NAV is below the higher of the HWM or reference hurdle, no incentive fee is payable for that period.
